lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: You're bound for the graveyard road. I can see it in how you grip that sword.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: I kept the gate there for eleven years. Last week the gate began keeping me out.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: A shield goes further beside a blade. Shall I walk with you?

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: Then keep behind my shield when the dead come close. [The Warden joins the party.]

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: As you like. I'll be here, watching the road.
